text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! First up today was the magazine 
interview, right?
choice_data_list:
Yeah. After that, there's the photo shoot 
and interview too.

Yeah. After this, we still have a 
photoshoot and an interview.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, that's right! Kufufu... Windy-chan is 
super popular~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy excelled in numerous major 
races and became highly sought after by 
the media.
choice_data_list: Let's live up to everyone's expectations!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Of cooourse! Let's go, Trainer! Let's make 
Windy-chan's 'infamy' even more 
widespread~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...However, a few days later—
choice_data_list:
We got an offer for a TV appearance. What 
do you want to do?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
! A-Again!? We just finished a photoshoot 
the other day, didn't weeee?!?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh, uuuuugh~...! I want to go, but I 
don't wanna go, nodaa~!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"I haven't had an ounce of fun lately! 
Give me a little break, Trainer~!"
choice_data_list:
Alright, let's just make tomorrow a day 
off!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ! R-Really?! Yaaaay!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you know about the amusement 
park's Halloween event?! To tell you the 
truth, I've beeeen wanting to go♪
choice_data_list: That's great! Go have tons of fun.
Sounds good! Go have lots of fun!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...? What are you saying? Of course you're 
coming with me!
choice_data_list: Huh, me too?
Huh, me too?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Of course it is! It's only natural for an 
underling to stick with their boss!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, it's a hard-earned day off! We 
gotta play, play, and play until we drop~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ohh... ooooh! Look at that massive roller 
coaster!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
And there's a Ferris wheel too! Heheh, I 
wonder which one I should ride first~♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ooh...! "Pumpkin Churros"!? Let's go, 
Trainer! First, we fuel up~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Mumu...! This area is incredible! It's 
just like a movie...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
This vehicle... I can't believe how much 
detail went into making it...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I can use this for my next prank! Trainer, 
let's go check it out together!
choice_data_list:
Yeah! Let's ride until our hearts are 
content.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Uuu! This horror house... It certainly 
lives up to its claim as the scariest...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Nodaaaaaaah!?
choice_data_list: Eep! J-Just now, that voice...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Hehe, hehehe! W-What are you scared 
of?! This is obviously just a simple 
gimmick!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
L-Listen up! Don't you dare leave 
Windy-chan's side! Promise me! Absolutely, 
positively! That's an order from your 
Boss~!
choice_data_list: A-Ah! Just leave it to me...!
Y-Yeah! Leave it to me...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And after that, time flew by in the 
blink of an eye—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Phew! That roller coaster is amazing! No 
matter how many times I ride it, it never 
fails to thrill me♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Amusement parks really are the best... 
*yaaawn*—
choice_data_list:
We've had our fill of fun, shall we head 
home soon?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, what're you talking about? The real 
show starts now... Just watch!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inside the paper bag handed to me was a 
collection filled with horror-themed 
costume props and prank toys...!
choice_data_list: Th-This is...!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh... The truth is, there's a 
costume party after this!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
What's more! Since it's Halloween, we're 
allowed to play pranks too! It's the 
perfect event for the Great Demon King~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
True, there's still plenty of time before 
the dorm curfew. There shouldn't be any 
problem with participating.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, shouldn't she be heading home 
soon? She seems worn out from playing, so 
wouldn't stopping be in her best interest—
choice_data_list: (...No, but—)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Of course it is! It's only natural for an 
underling to stick with their boss!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, it's a hard-earned day off! We 
gotta play, play, and play until we drop~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...? What is the matter, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Alright, I'll follow you wherever you go!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
! Fufu... Fufufu! Now that's what I'm 
talking about!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's do this! Windy-chan and the 
gang's prank is gonna scare everyone here 
out of their wits~!
choice_data_list: Huh, all of them!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Of course I do! Nishishi... I won't let 
you say "no," got it?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: After all, you're Windy-chan's underling!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Let's go! First, that one over— 
*yaaawn*...
choice_data_list: Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! No problem at all! If I get sleepy, 
you can just carry Windy-chan on your 
back!
choice_data_list: Huh, me!?
Huh, me!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, you're one lucky dog! Having the 
boss rely on you this much♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's settled, let's meet up! 
I've already prepared several plans, after 
all!
choice_data_list: Whatever the plan is, I'll see it through!

No matter what the plan is, I'll see it 
through!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
! Fufu, that's the spirit! You make for 
quite an excellent lackey.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, Trainer! We're gonna fill this 
amusement park with pure terror! 
Mwahahaha~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Let's go! To make up for not getting any 
breaks, I'm gonna run wild~!
choice_data_list:
You worked hard dealing with the media, 
didn't you?

You did great handling the media, didn't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! So, I'm gonna pull pranks to my 
heart's content today!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"So... starting tomorrow, Windy-chan's 
gonna do her best again! All to spread my 
villainous name far and wide!"
